This hearing has been done through hybrid mode.

2. The present application under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. seeks regular bail in case FIR No.
815/2022, under Sections 498A/306/34 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Subhash Place.

3. During the pendency of the present bail application, it was brought to the attention of this Court that examination-in-chief of the 3 main witnesses, i.e., PW-1/Gurpreet Singh (brother of the deceased), PW-6/Ranjeet Kaur (sister-in-law of the deceased) and PW-7/Jitender Singh has been deferred on account of certain FSL reports.
4. Vide order dated 18.02.2025, this Court had directed the concerned DCP to take necessary steps and file the report with regard to filing of the FSL report before the learned Trial Court.
On 22.04.2025, this Court was informed that one of the FSL reports with respect to the DNA profile of the deceased This is a digitally signed order.

sentences.text: Learned APP for the State submits that priority letter was sent to the FSL, however, there is no response from the FSL as to when the said reports shall be obtained.

It is further submitted that the allegations in the chargesheet is that the applicant had attacked the brother of the deceased, i.e.,
PW- 1/Gurpreet Singh with a sword and CCTV footage with respect to the same is awaited from the FSL.
It is submitted that the said witness is still under examination and the apprehension of the prosecution is that the present applicant may threaten the said witness.

6. Learned Senior Counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that the applicant has been in custody since 28.06.2023 and out of 24 witnesses, only 4 have been examined and 3 witnesses are under examination- in-chief and the remaining witnesses also remain to be examined.

It is further pointed out that necessary conditions may be imposed on the applicant in order to ensure that the evidence of the aforesaid 3 witnesses who are under examination-in-chief can be conducted.
7. In the aforesaid circumstances, it is clear that there is no clear date as to when the FSL report will be received by the prosecution which is to be placed before the learned Trial Court.

In these circumstances, this Court is of the considered opinion that the applicant may be released on interim bail during the pendency of the present bail application with certain conditions to ensure that the witnesses under examination are not influenced in any manner.
8. In these circumstances, the applicant is directed to be released on interim bail during the pendency of the present bail application, on his This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 09/07/2025 at 22:20:55 furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- with two sureties of like amount, subject to the satisfaction of learned Trial Court/Link Court, further subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant shall not leave the NCT of Delhi without prior permission of this Court.

ii. The applicant shall report at the concerned Police Station, once in a week, i.e., on every Friday at 04:00 P.M. and the concerned officer is directed to release him by 04:30 P.M. after recording his presence and completion of all the necessary formalities.
iii. The applicant shall intimate the learned Trial Court by way of an affidavit and to the Investigating Officer regarding any change in residential address.
iv. The applicant shall appear before the learned Trial Court as and when the matter is taken up for hearing.
v. The applicant is directed to give his mobile number to the Investigating Officer and keep it operational at all times.
